injuries.name: Warren Foegele
injuries.note: Foegele has been sidelined since late October, and he initially carried a return timetable of 3-4 weeks. While he hasn't yet entered that window, the fact that he hasn't yet resumed skating suggests that he isn't particularly close to returning to game action. A better idea of the 30-year-old's timetable to return will likely come into focus once he's cleared to return to the ice.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Eklund's timeline would seem to indicate that he will be out of action until the calendar flips to 2027, though it's possible he makes a late-December return if on the early side of his timeline. While the 24-year-old winger is already on injured reserve, he could be a candidate for long-term injured reserve if the Senators need the cap space to make a move.

injuries.name: Victor Hedman
injuries.note: Hedman's exit wasn't related to the illness that cost him Wednesday's game versus the Hurricanes. The 35-year-old can be considered day-to-day leading into Saturday's game versus the Panthers.

injuries.name: Erik Cernak
injuries.note: Cernak also missed Wednesday's game against Carolina. He has nine assists in 20 appearances in 2026-27. Cernak's next opportunity to return will come Saturday versus Florida.

injuries.name: Conor Geekie
injuries.note: Geekie is in line to miss the majority of the 2026-27 campaign following Tuesday's news. It's a tough break for the 22-year-old forward, as he had carved out an everyday role for the Lightning. Prior to going down, he compiled four goals, five points, 27 shots on net, 59 hits and eight blocked shots across 20 appearances. Given his 4-5 month timeline for return, he'll have a chance to return in late March or early April, barring he's not shut down for the year.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Ankle: The Ottawa Senators said on Thursday (Oct. 15) that Eklund is expected to miss the next 10-12 weeks.

injuries.name: Warren Foegele
injuries.note: Knee: The Ottawa Senators said that Foegele hasn't resumed skating as of Monday (Nov. 16).

injuries.name: Erik Cernak
injuries.note: Illness: Cernak is OUT for Friday's (Nov. 27) game versus the Senators.

injuries.name: Conor Geekie
injuries.note: Upper Body: Geekie underwent surgery Monday (Nov. 23) and is expected to miss 4-5 months.

injuries.name: Victor Hedman
injuries.note: Undisclosed: Hedman didn't finish Friday's (Nov. 27) game versus the Senators, Benjamin Pierce of the Lightning's official site reports.

injuries.name: Pontus Holmberg
injuries.note: Lower Body: The Tampa Bay Lightning placed F Pontus Holmberg on injured reserve.
